[NTST.7.1] A rule that emits a derived fact `logical` ties the derived
fact's lifetime to its premise: retracting the premise retracts the derived
fact through truth maintenance. A test of it asserts the premise, pumps,
observes the derived fact's `DS_EV_FACT_ASSERT`, retracts the premise, pumps
again, and observes its `DS_EV_FACT_RETRACT`. Justifier introspection
(`ds_engine_get_justifiers`, [NDBG.5]) lets a test assert *which* activation
supports the derived fact.
